content.json:
# Fishpond Math Hammer usage
Anonymous usage from the production site. A *visitor* is one browser (anonymous cookie ID).

content.title: Overview

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "AppOpen"
| summarize Visits = count(), Visitors = dcount(user_Id) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Visits and visitors per day

content.query:
let labels = datatable(name:string, Feature:string)[
 "Run40KSimulation","Run 40K Simulation",
 "Profile","Profile",
 "Comparison","Comparison",
 "CopyReport","Copy Report",
 "RunAoSSimulation","Run AoS Simulation",
 "DiceCalculator","Dice Calculator",
 "DiceRoller","Dice Roller",
 "CheatSheet","Cheat Sheet",
 "TacticalBoard","Tactical Board",
 "BoardTools","Board Tools",
 "AddBase","Add Base",
 "MissionCard","Mission Card",
 "RecordVP","Record VP"];
customEvents
| where name != "AppOpen"
| summarize Users = dcount(user_Id) by name
| join kind=rightouter labels on name
| project Feature, Users = coalesce(Users, 0)
| order by Users desc
content.title: Users per feature

content.query:
let labels = datatable(name:string, Feature:string)[
 "Run40KSimulation","Run 40K Simulation",
 "Profile","Profile",
 "Comparison","Comparison",
 "CopyReport","Copy Report",
 "RunAoSSimulation","Run AoS Simulation",
 "DiceCalculator","Dice Calculator",
 "DiceRoller","Dice Roller",
 "CheatSheet","Cheat Sheet",
 "TacticalBoard","Tactical Board",
 "BoardTools","Board Tools",
 "AddBase","Add Base",
 "MissionCard","Mission Card",
 "RecordVP","Record VP"];
let visitors = toscalar(customEvents | where name == "AppOpen" | summarize dcount(user_Id));
customEvents
| where name != "AppOpen"
| summarize Uses = count(), Users = dcount(user_Id) by name
| join kind=rightouter labels on name
| project Feature, Uses = coalesce(Uses, 0), Users = coalesce(Users, 0)
| extend ["Usage rate %"] = iff(visitors == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Users / visitors, 1))
| order by Users desc
content.title: Feature usage

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "TacticalBoard"
| summarize Uses = count(), Users = dcount(user_Id) by Map = tostring(customDimensions.map)
| order by Uses desc
content.title: Tactical Board maps

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "BoardTools"
| summarize Uses = count(), Users = dcount(user_Id) by Tool = tostring(customDimensions.tool)
| order by Uses desc
content.title: Board tools

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "Profile"
| summarize Uses = count(), Users = dcount(user_Id) by Action = tostring(customDimensions.action)
| order by Uses desc
content.title: Profile actions

content.query:
customEvents
| summarize Users = dcount(user_Id) by Language = tostring(customDimensions.language)
content.title: Users by language

content.query:
let labels = datatable(name:string, Feature:string)[
 "Run40KSimulation","Run 40K Simulation",
 "Profile","Profile",
 "Comparison","Comparison",
 "CopyReport","Copy Report",
 "RunAoSSimulation","Run AoS Simulation",
 "DiceCalculator","Dice Calculator",
 "DiceRoller","Dice Roller",
 "CheatSheet","Cheat Sheet",
 "TacticalBoard","Tactical Board",
 "BoardTools","Board Tools",
 "AddBase","Add Base",
 "MissionCard","Mission Card",
 "RecordVP","Record VP"];
customEvents
| where name != "AppOpen"
| summarize Users = dcount(user_Id) by name, Language = tostring(customDimensions.language)
| join kind=inner labels on name
| project Feature, Language, Users
| evaluate pivot(Language, sum(Users))
content.title: Feature users by language
